The '''father''' of [[Gerran]] was a member of the [[Doan Royal House]] and [[King/Legends|King]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. He was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] Gerran, and he opposed to Gerran's marriage to [[Serra]]. Around this time, the Doan Royal House came into conflict with the planet's [[mining caste]]. In [[980 BBY]], his son was accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] when members of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] caste attempted to force his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] into an emergency landing. In revenge, Serra's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], hired [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]], in [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], to assassinate those responsible for Gerran's death.<ref name="DOE" />

The Huntress [[Massacre on Doan|ambushed]] and killed [[Gelba]], a mining caste leader, as well as five miners that she was with at the time and a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Medd Tandar]], who had been sent to Doan to negotiate between the Royal House and the miners. This caused a diplomatic incident, as the King worried that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] would assume that the Royal House had arranged the attack, when in reality he and Serra had nothing to do with it. As such, Serra traveled to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to speak with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and convince them that the murder of Tandar was not the Royal House's fault. Later, Serra was killed by the Huntress&mdash;who had become [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], taking on the name of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Cognus&mdash;on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], leaving the King to be the only surviving member of his family.<ref name="DOE" />
